#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    int valid = 0;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if ((arr[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd) {
            ++valid;
        }
    }

    vector<int> costs;
    even = 0;
    odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if ((arr[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd) {
            costs.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    int budget = B;
    long long ans = 0;
    if (budget >= 0) {
        for (int c : costs) {
            budget -= c;
            if (budget < 0) {
                break;
            }
            ++ans;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
